decision.observation: 6 mph, gear R, timer 09:13.103, all dots pale. The car has backed a few metres and is now sitting next to the barrel row at the inside edge of the left bend; the gravel surface is immediately behind-left of it and the barrels are now beside its right flank.
decision.hypothesis: Reverse freed it cleanly. Continuing to back straight for another second should clear the barrels and settle on the gravel, after which a forward run can take the bend; backing further is safer than steering right next to the barrels.
decision.memory: Plain S from a barrel pin gives a gradual, controllable reverse (0 -> 6 mph per second) without stall.
